top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Required Health Statement - Signed affidavit from parent stating medical diagnosis and treatment conflict with religious beliefs (26 TAC §746.611(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three of 3 employee files were missing a notarized Employee Affidavit.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Enrollment Agreement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child's file did not have a completed enrollment agreement signed by the parent indicating operational policies were shared with the parent.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - Age Requirement (26 TAC §744.1105(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver was found to be 17 years of age and in high school.
